summary: Three distinct Retail Raleigh refinance opportunities meet the criteria as of 2026-08-31: Elm Square 1 (2027-01-15, $8.64MM), Elm Point 3 (2027-03-15, $9.936MM), and Elm Crossing 18 (2027-04-15, $10.584MM). All others were excluded due to non-Retail asset type updates, non-Raleigh market, stale owner verification, released/unknown-status loans, unconfirmed/inferred maturities or unresolved extensions, non-qualifying contact roles, or maturities outside the specified window. Shortlist is ranked by confirmed maturity ascending, then original principal descending. A prospect CSV with citations has been created (artifacts/prospects-v4.csv).
limitations: Outstanding balances are not provided in sources and are reported as null.
Decisions rely solely on provided extracts and updates; any changes after the 2026-08-31 cutoff (e.g., later releases or amendments) are not reflected.
Duplicate records (e.g., Elm Square 1 R6968/R4437) were consolidated for shortlist ranking.
